QF.id: Registration, Code of Conduct and General Obligations_30

question.text: For how many years must a merchant banker maintain its books of accounts and records under Regulation 14?

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 14 requires merchant bankers to maintain the listed books of accounts and records for a minimum period of 8 years. This is the retention period applicable to the maintenance obligation. The Trap: The 5-year figure is tempting because Regulation 14 separately requires the merchant banker to furnish records of the preceding 5 accounting years when required by SEBI. That is a furnishing obligation, not the retention period. Note: Distinguish two distinct numbers in the same regulation: an 8-year minimum retention period and a separate requirement to furnish the preceding 5 accounting years on demand.
